lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (3): Line graph — trendlar, asosiy nuqtalar va taxminiy raqamlar
lessons.grammar_topic: Line graph: trend tili (fe'l + ravish va sifat + ot), asosiy nuqtalar (boshlanish, burilish, cho'qqi, eng past, oxir), taxmin va prognoz
lessons.vocab_topic: Trend va raqam tili: rise, decline, peak, plateau, overtake, fluctuate; approximately, just over, roughly; is expected to

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (4): Bar chart — trend yoki solishtirma grafik, eng ko'p va eng kam
lessons.grammar_topic: Bar chart: vaqtli (trend) va vaqtsiz (solishtirma) bar grafikni ajratish; solishtirish tili (higher than, twice as many, the figure for), number / amount / proportion / percentage, birlik aniqligi
lessons.vocab_topic: Solishtirish tili: compared with, whereas, twice as many as, slightly higher, the highest proportion, the figure for, respectively

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (5): Pie chart + Table — ulushlar, kasrlar va jadvaldan asosiy ma'lumotni tanlash
lessons.grammar_topic: Pie chart va table: foiz → kasr iboralari (a quarter, just under a third), accounted for / made up, ikki pie solishtirish, jadvaldan qator/ustunni guruhlash, solishtirish aniqligi
lessons.vocab_topic: Ulush tili: proportion, share, a quarter, just under a third, the vast majority, a small fraction, accounted for, made up, doubled, a tenfold increase

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (6): Process diagram — bosqichlar, passiv va ketma-ketlik
lessons.grammar_topic: Process diagram: bosqichlarni sanash (overview), present simple passive, ketma-ketlik bog'lovchilari (first, next, once, after which, finally), sun'iy (man-made) va tabiiy (natural) jarayon, tarmoqlanuvchi jarayon
lessons.vocab_topic: Jarayon tili: is collected, is transported, is sorted, is melted, is spun, is woven; first, next, once, after which, at the following stage, finally; consists of, stages

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (7): Map — joylashuv, o'zgarishlar va kirish shablonlari
lessons.grammar_topic: Map: joylashuv va yo'nalish (to the north of, adjacent to, opposite, alongside), o'zgarish passivi (was demolished, was replaced by, was converted into, made way for), o'tgan va kelajak (taklif qilingan) xaritalar, kirish shablonlari; Task 1 blok yakuni
lessons.vocab_topic: Xarita tili: north-east, adjacent to, opposite, alongside, was demolished, was replaced by, was converted into, was extended, made way for, remained unchanged, is to be built
